# 打捞者城邦被毁 / Salvager Enclave Destroyed

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：霸主 Overlord
- 来源 Sources：events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt:6642（enclave.370）, :6678（enclave.375）, :6701（enclave.380）; events/observer_events.txt:1590（observer.90）; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1424
- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（C6）

## 如何开始 How it starts
打捞者城邦空间站被击毁时（on_ship_destroyed_victim → 隐藏 enclave.370）。When the Salvager station is destroyed.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
按视角收到一种通知（互斥）：摧毁者 enclave.375（胜利宣言）；其他有通讯的帝国 enclave.380（惋惜失去服务）；观察者 observer.90。
One notice per viewpoint: the destroyer gets enclave.375, other empires in contact get enclave.380, observers get observer.90.
此后“打捞者城邦”的联络菜单及其服务不再可用。The Salvager contact menu and its services end.
